{
  "name": "civicfix-api",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "City Complaint & Service Platform - CivicFix Backend API",
  "main": "dist/server.js",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "tsx watch src/server.ts",
    "build": "prisma generate && tsup",
    "start": "node dist/server.js",
    "vercel-build": "prisma generate && prisma migrate deploy && tsup",
    "postinstall": "prisma generate",
    "prisma:generate": "prisma generate",
    "prisma:migrate": "prisma migrate dev",
    "prisma:deploy": "prisma migrate deploy",
    "prisma:seed": "tsx prisma/seed.ts",
    "lint": "biome check .",
    "format": "biome format --write ."
  },
  "prisma": {
    "seed": "tsx prisma/seed.ts"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "civicfix",
    "complaints",
    "city-service",
    "express",
    "prisma"
  ],
  "author": "CivicFix",
  "license": "MIT",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@prisma/client": "^5.22.0",
    "axios": "^1.7.9",
    "bcryptjs": "^2.4.3",
    "cloudinary": "^2.5.1",
    "cors": "^2.8.5",
    "dotenv": "^16.4.7",
    "express": "^4.21.2",
    "express-rate-limit": "^7.5.0",
    "google-auth-library": "^9.15.1",
    "helmet": "^8.0.0",
    "ioredis": "^5.4.2",
    "jsonwebtoken": "^9.0.2",
    "multer": "^1.4.5-lts.1",
    "zod": "^3.24.1"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@biomejs/biome": "^1.9.4",
    "@types/bcryptjs": "^2.4.6",
    "@types/cors": "^2.8.17",
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/jsonwebtoken": "^9.0.7",
    "@types/multer": "^1.4.12",
    "@types/node": "^22.10.5",
    "prisma": "^5.22.0",
    "tsup": "^8.5.1",
    "tsx": "^4.19.2",
    "typescript": "^5.7.2"
  }
}

{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "CommonJS",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "dist",
    "rootDir": "src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "sourceMap": true,
    "moduleResolution": "node"
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "prisma"]
}

import { defineConfig } from "tsup";

export default defineConfig({
  entry: ["src/server.ts"],
  format: ["cjs"],
  target: "node18",
  outDir: "dist",
  clean: true,
  bundle: true,
  splitting: false,
  sourcemap: true,
  dts: false,
  // Keep Prisma external so it can load its query engine binaries correctly
  external: ["@prisma/client", ".prisma/client"],
  noExternal: [
    "express",
    "cors",
    "helmet",
    "express-rate-limit",
    "bcryptjs",
    "jsonwebtoken",
    "zod",
    "dotenv",
    "axios",
    "ioredis",
    "cloudinary",
    "google-auth-library",
    "multer",
  ],
});

# Please do not edit this file manually
# It should be added in your version-control system (i.e. Git)
provider = "postgresql"

generator client {
  provider      = "prisma-client-js"
  binaryTargets = ["native", "rhel-openssl-3.0.x"]
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Role {
  CITIZEN
  STAFF
  ADMIN
}

enum ComplaintStatus {
  SUBMITTED
  UNDER_REVIEW
  ASSIGNED
  IN_PROGRESS
  RESOLVED
  CLOSED
  REJECTED
  CANCELLED
}

enum Priority {
  STANDARD
  PRIORITY
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  PENDING
  COMPLETED
  FAILED
  CANCELLED
}

model User {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  email        String    @unique
  passwordHash String?
  name         String
  phone        String?
  role         Role      @default(CITIZEN)
  googleId     String?   @unique
  avatarUrl    String?
  address      String?
  isActive     Boolean   @default(true)
  departmentId String?
  department   Department? @relation(fields: [departmentId], references: [id])
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt
  deletedAt    DateTime?

  complaintsSubmitted Complaint[]      @relation("CitizenComplaints")
  complaintsAssigned  Complaint[]      @relation("AssignedStaff")
  complaintUpdates    ComplaintUpdate[]
  refreshTokens       RefreshToken[]
  auditLogs           AuditLog[]
  payments            Payment[]
  feedbacks           Feedback[]

  @@index([role])
  @@index([departmentId])
  @@index([deletedAt])
  @@map("users")
}

model Department {
  id          String     @id @default(cuid())
  name        String     @unique
  code        String     @unique
  description String?
  isActive    Boolean    @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime   @updatedAt
  deletedAt   DateTime?

  staff      User[]
  categories Category[]
  complaints Complaint[]

  @@index([deletedAt])
  @@map("departments")
}

model Category {
  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  name         String
  slug         String     @unique
  description  String?
  slaHours     Int        @default(72)
  departmentId String
  department   Department @relation(fields: [departmentId], references: [id])
  isActive     Boolean    @default(true)
  createdAt    DateTime   @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime   @updatedAt
  deletedAt    DateTime?

  complaints Complaint[]

  @@index([departmentId])
  @@index([deletedAt])
  @@map("categories")
}

model Complaint {
  id             String          @id @default(cuid())
  trackingId     String          @unique
  title          String
  description    String
  status         ComplaintStatus @default(SUBMITTED)
  priority       Priority        @default(STANDARD)
  location       String
  latitude       Float?
  longitude      Float?
  citizenId      String
  citizen        User            @relation("CitizenComplaints", fields: [citizenId], references: [id])
  categoryId     String
  category       Category        @relation(fields: [categoryId], references: [id])
  departmentId   String
  department     Department      @relation(fields: [departmentId], references: [id])
  assignedToId   String?
  assignedTo     User?           @relation("AssignedStaff", fields: [assignedToId], references: [id])
  slaDueAt       DateTime
  resolvedAt     DateTime?
  rejectionReason String?
  createdAt      DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime        @updatedAt
  deletedAt      DateTime?

  updates     ComplaintUpdate[]
  attachments Attachment[]
  feedback    Feedback?
  payments    Payment[]

  @@index([status])
  @@index([priority])
  @@index([citizenId])
  @@index([assignedToId])
  @@index([departmentId])
  @@index([categoryId])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@index([deletedAt])
  @@index([slaDueAt])
  @@map("complaints")
}

model ComplaintUpdate {
  id          String           @id @default(cuid())
  complaintId String
  complaint   Complaint        @relation(fields: [complaintId], references: [id])
  actorId     String
  actor       User             @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id])
  fromStatus  ComplaintStatus?
  toStatus    ComplaintStatus?
  note        String?
  createdAt   DateTime         @default(now())

  @@index([complaintId])
  @@index([actorId])
  @@map("complaint_updates")
}

model Attachment {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  complaintId  String
  complaint    Complaint @relation(fields: [complaintId], references: [id])
  url          String
  publicId     String?
  mimeType     String?
  originalName String?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([complaintId])
  @@map("attachments")
}

model Feedback {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  complaintId String    @unique
  complaint   Complaint @relation(fields: [complaintId], references: [id])
  citizenId   String
  citizen     User      @relation(fields: [citizenId], references: [id])
  rating      Int
  comment     String?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([citizenId])
  @@map("feedbacks")
}

model Payment {
  id                    String        @id @default(cuid())
  complaintId           String
  complaint             Complaint     @relation(fields: [complaintId], references: [id])
  citizenId             String
  citizen               User          @relation(fields: [citizenId], references: [id])
  amount                Decimal       @db.Decimal(10, 2)
  currency              String        @default("BDT")
  status                PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  merchantInvoiceNumber String        @unique
  bkashPaymentId        String?       @unique
  trxId                 String?
  bkashResponse         Json?
  paidAt                DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime      @updatedAt

  @@index([complaintId])
  @@index([citizenId])
  @@index([status])
  @@map("payments")
}

model RefreshToken {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  token     String    @unique
  userId    String
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  revokedAt DateTime?

  @@index([userId])
  @@map("refresh_tokens")
}

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  actorId    String?
  actor      User?    @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id])
  action     String
  entityType String
  entityId   String?
  metadata   Json?
  ipAddress  String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([actorId])
  @@index([entityType])
  @@index([createdAt])
  @@map("audit_logs")
}
